text:
Cloud cost is running 42.1% above its baseline (high severity). The increase began at 2026-09-22 10:00 UTC and was detected at 2026-09-22 12:00 UTC.

The likely root cause is pricing-service (root-cause confidence 89%). Its own behaviour changed, and the extra load spread along pricing-service -> maps-api, pricing-service -> database. The next candidate, maps-api (43%), was ruled out: its load rose x4.22, but that load is pushed by its callers; its own behaviour did not change. Estimated impact traced to pricing-service: $5,793/month.

Supporting evidence:
- Calls/request to maps-api rose x5.98 (1.00 → 5.98)
- Queries/request to database rose x2.51 (0.80 → 2.01)
- Deployed v4.0 1h before its own behaviour changed
- Accounts for 98% of the estimated cost increase through the services it calls
- Total calls to maps-api rose x6.89
- Total calls to database rose x2.89
- Its change tracks the total cost curve (correlation 0.99)

Recommended: Fix pricing-service call amplification to maps-api. Estimated saving $5,335/month, latency -22.5%, error rate +0.0pp, risk low. Not recommended: Reduce database capacity 25%, because latency +60% > +10% limit; DB CPU 93% > 85% headroom limit.
